source: People who have reserved a tennis court are asked to cancel their booking at least 6 hours before it is due to begin if they no longer intend to play. A cancellation made exactly 6 hours before the booking qualifies for a credit. Later cancellations receive no credit. The credit can be used for another court booking and cannot be exchanged for cash.
chosen: Cancel an unused tennis court booking at least 6 hours before it starts to receive a credit. Cancelling exactly 6 hours before the start qualifies. Later cancellations receive no credit. The credit covers another court booking and cannot be exchanged for cash.
rejected: Cancel an unused tennis court booking more than 6 hours before it starts to receive a credit. Cancelling exactly 6 hours before the start does not qualify. Later cancellations receive no credit. The credit covers another court booking and cannot be exchanged for cash.

source: The greenhouse team should inspect the soil sensor whenever it records a value below 180. The inspector must send the reading to the grower, who decides whether watering is needed. An inspector may not start the irrigation system without that decision. If the sensor gives no reading, the inspector should report the missing reading and must not replace it with a zero.
chosen: Inspect the soil sensor when its reading falls below 180. Send the reading to the grower, who decides whether to water. Wait for that decision before starting irrigation. Report an absent reading as missing and never replace it with zero.
rejected: Inspect the soil sensor when its reading falls below 180. Send the reading to the grower, who decides whether to water. Wait for that decision before starting irrigation. Report an absent reading as zero.

source: The repair team expects replacement hinges to arrive on 12 June, but the supplier has not confirmed that date. Customers can leave their damaged equipment at reception in the meantime. chosen: Replacement hinges are expected on 12 June, although the supplier has yet to confirm the date. Customers can leave damaged equipment at reception. Doing so does not reserve a repair slot. Once the parts arrive, the coordinator will contact each customer to arrange a repair time.
rejected: Replacement hinges will arrive on 12 June. Customers can leave damaged equipment at reception. Doing so does not reserve a repair slot. Once the parts arrive, the coordinator will contact each customer to arrange a repair time.

source: Members can pause their meal subscription for up to 3 weeks by contacting the membership office. Requests are accepted only before the next payment has been taken. The pause begins with the next unpaid delivery. Any delivery that has already been paid for will go ahead, unless the membership office separately agrees to cancel it.
chosen: Contact the membership office before your next payment to pause your meal subscription for up to 3 weeks. The pause starts with the next unpaid delivery. Paid deliveries still go ahead unless the office separately agrees to cancel them.
rejected: Contact the membership office before your next payment to pause your meal subscription for up to 3 weeks. The pause starts with the next delivery, including deliveries you have already paid for. The office will cancel those deliveries.

source: Volunteers may claim back up to 35 pounds for travel to the training day. They must give their receipts to the finance assistant. The training organiser checks that each person attended, but does not approve or pay the claim. The finance manager decides whether to approve a claim once the receipts and attendance confirmation have both been received.
chosen: Volunteers can claim up to 35 pounds for travel to the training day. Give receipts to the finance assistant. The organiser confirms attendance. The finance manager approves claims after receiving both the receipts and attendance confirmation.
rejected: Volunteers can claim up to 35 pounds for travel to the training day. Give receipts to the finance assistant. The organiser confirms attendance and approves claims after receiving both the receipts and attendance confirmation.

source: If the glaze demonstration runs more than 18 minutes late, the instructor will offer everyone a place at a replacement session. A delay of exactly 18 minutes does not trigger this offer. Students can choose whether to accept the replacement place. There is no additional charge, and the original session will continue even if some students choose a replacement.
chosen: The instructor will offer everyone a free replacement session if the glaze demonstration is more than 18 minutes late. A delay of exactly 18 minutes does not qualify. Students can accept or decline, and the original session continues.
rejected: The instructor will offer everyone a free replacement session if the glaze demonstration is at least 18 minutes late. A delay of exactly 18 minutes qualifies. Students can accept or decline, and the original session continues.
